steps.content: The Corruptors invading your consciousness are gradually expelled. At the same time, you slowly adapt to the disorderly datasets of Mania around you. They infiltrate deep into your consciousness, flickering on and off.
There are blurry faces, whispered words, dim lights and shadows. Slowly, you begin to identify certain emotions and desires.
Come to think of it, it could be said that she... grew up here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said it's your first time outside, first time chatting face-to-face with someone. What about before that? Were you hiding in the dark web?
Yeah, it's a great invention. You can see the whole world without leaving home. Oh, and a lot of info you can't even imagine is in that sea of data.
You strive to discern, hoping to find clues buried in the depths of the dark web and find the mastermind behind it all.
...But in the end, what you see are only some familiar yet blurry images.
There are those who cannot see the light of day. There's no place for them in this city, so they turn to dwell in the shadows.
There is dark and endless malice that has found a gutter, swarming and churning in wanton revelry.
There are those forgotten, abandoned, and powerless to come ashore, who can only cling to Mania like an addiction and grasp onto illusory dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Isn't it dangerous? Crime, malice... plenty of things that can't see the light of day lurk there.
Yeah, just like me. I can't see the light of day...
Before coming to see you, I always hid deep in the dark web. There, I could do many things without being discovered.
You hesitate briefly, then move forward to delve deeper.
The deeper end of the domain resembles a massive black hole. Entering it, your consciousness flickers on and off. It's as if your mind is being broken into 0s and 1s, merging with the surroundings.
After a while, you reach a boundary; a shallow, untouchable barrier.
On the other side of the barrier, specks of light flicker and coalesce into both strange and familiar shadows. They scatter in different directions, passing through walls and disappearing from view.
They probably went to different worlds.
Perhaps... this is the place where she first embraced the world.
Hi.
It's an auditory hallucination, but you hear it. Following the vague apparition, you find...
A bit of residual light in an empty area.
You hold the residual data, and fragmented memories tickle your mind.
Some thoughts you don't recognize, while others you remember vividly... These might also awaken your own memories.
Finally, you see 000 on the summer street where you first met. The smile she had is gone, and tears are rolling down her cheeks.
...Ha... Turns out that person is just like me...
Me? In what way am I like her? Equally reckless? Stubborn?
You can no longer ask for an answer.
The fragmented memories brush past your consciousness and dissolve into the darkness.
A series of intermittent comms messages pulls you back to reality.
<color=#a0ffea>■■■■ and Sinner ■■■000■■■ Mania data match ■■■■■■ This is the last trace she left when she was deleted.</color>
<color=#a0ffea> After sustaining so much damage ■■ even if ■■■ took her through the dark ■■■ web data ■■■ storm, ■■■ center has no one ■■ who can ■■■ restore her.</color>
<color=#a0ffea> But ■■■ don't worry ■■■ since this ■■■ higher ■■■ decide to erase her completely from ■■■ world, it won't be long before you ■■■ can forget ■■■.</color>
<color=#a0ffea> Or do you ■■■ want to ■■■ another request, and ask me to ■■■ save her? </color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Do I really want to save her?

steps.content: No.
Why ask such a question at this point?
You didn't accept those reports and conclusions, nor the storyline's return to normalcy...
Isn't it precisely because you hated such an arrangement?
You chose to take a risk, coming to this obscure place without knowing anything...
Isn't it because you wanted to find another answer?
Isn't the different possibility you wanted right in the palm of your hand?
...Why not give it a try?

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: Just think of it like a game, and... Let's play big.
That's right, since it's a game...
We must clear the level properly.
[Tap the circle in your hand]
You bring the remaining data in your hand to your mouth, and swallow it all.
Information, data, and intelligence seep into your consciousness. It's the residue of a fragmented mind... no, a newborn soul.
It's her desires, struggles, and madness born from the darkest void. Now all of this turns into poison, seeping into your existence.
Then...
[Scene transition, perspective shift] (Performance)
The isolation room in the Cybersecurity Center where Chief is located suddenly erupts into a storm. Countless rifts tear open, just like the outbreak not long ago.

steps.speaker: Technician
steps.content: Chief has come into contact with anomalous data and suffered total mental contamination! This is an ultra-high intensity dark web anomaly!

steps.speaker: Technician
steps.content: Wait, are those... shackles?!
[BUG Chief CG]
Mania rages on, with spatial matter continuously splitting apart. The chaotic data is tearing this world asunder.
The shackles in ${PlayerName}'s palm start to shatter, dissolving into countless specks of light that split and reform into more destructive forms.
In ${PlayerName}'s eyes, the world begins to dissolve. The physical body and the room lose their original forms, turning into chaotic data that disperses and reassembles.
The light of the shackles tears apart the room where the Chief stays, as if 000 has returned to rip the world apart with a manic storm.
steps.female_content: The light of the shackles tears apart the room confining her, as if 000 has returned to rip the world apart with a manic storm.

steps.content: A huge barrier presents itself before ${PlayerName}, separating the two worlds, the familiar and the unfamiliar, the real and the false.
On the other side of the barrier, a massive shadow is gathering warily, like a garrison on guard against an incoming enemy.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Haha, so you actually contaminated yourself... You are truly as crazy as she is.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I'd really like to see how far you can go, my good Chief. I look forward to the surprises you bring back, provided...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You are able to return.
[Release the shackles]
[Glitch explosion] [Flash to white, return to Cybersecurity Center] Transition for 2 seconds.
${PlayerName} disappears into thin air, leaving behind a room full of strange rifts.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: So... This is the job he gave me. As reckless as ever.
steps.female_content: So... This is the job she gave me. As reckless as ever.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: But I have to do it.
She rushes into the rift without hesitation, heading towards another unknown world.
[Glitch turns into white light]
Massive amounts of data converge into a blinding white light that pierces your brain. This time, no one sends you into a phone or helps you filter the information.
▌▌▌▌,▌▌▌▌▌ invasion▌: 5▌32▌world.
This is the world in 000's eyes. This is the enemy that she has been fighting all along. Now you understand the meaning behind the broken symbols... it's sheer conviction to obliterate the anomaly.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This time, I'll be the challenger.

steps.content:
<size=72>This chaotic, manic storm
has no impact on true fate.</size>
